places.name: Bokor National Park (Old French Hill Station)
places.ai_summary: Bokor National Park features lush forests, waterfalls, and the historic Old French Hill Station, offering a mix of nature and history.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited during daylight hours for safety.

places.place_tip: Bring a jacket as it can get chilly at higher altitudes.

places.name: Kampot Pepper Farms
places.ai_summary: Kampot Pepper Farms are renowned for producing some of the world’s finest pepper, offering tours to learn about the cultivation process.

opening_hours.notes: Guided tours are available at specific times.

places.place_tip: Purchase fresh pepper directly from the farms as a souvenir.

places.name: Kampot Riverside Promenade
places.ai_summary: The Kampot Riverside Promenade is a scenic walkway along the river, perfect for relaxing, dining, and enjoying the sunset.

opening_hours.notes: Best enjoyed during early morning or evening.

places.place_tip: Try the local seafood at nearby restaurants.

places.name: Kep National Park Trail
places.ai_summary: The Kep National Park Trail is a beautiful hiking route in Kep National Park, known for its diverse wildlife and scenic views.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited during the dry season.

places.place_tip: Wear sturdy shoes and bring water.

places.name: Kep Crab Market
places.ai_summary: Kep Crab Market is a famous seafood market in Kep, known for its fresh crabs and other seafood delicacies.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in the morning for fresh catches.

places.place_tip: Don't miss the crab omelette at the market stalls.

places.name: Kep Beach
places.ai_summary: Kep Beach is a serene beach in Kep, ideal for swimming, sunbathing, and enjoying fresh seafood from nearby shacks.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited during the dry season.

places.place_tip: Try the local grilled seafood.

places.name: Koh Tonsay (Rabbit Island)
places.ai_summary: Koh Tonsay, also known as Rabbit Island, is a tranquil island near Kep, famous for its white sandy beaches and clear waters.

opening_hours.notes: Accommodation available on the island.

places.place_tip: Bring cash as there are no ATMs on the island.

places.name: Phnom Chhngok Cave Temple
places.ai_summary: Phnom Chhngok Cave Temple is a historical site in a cave, featuring ancient stone carvings and a serene atmosphere.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in the morning.

places.place_tip: Respect the local customs and dress modestly.
places.address: Phnom Chhngok Cave Temple, Kampot, Cambodia

places.name: Kampot Old Market
places.ai_summary: Kampot Old Market is a traditional market in Kampot, offering a variety of local products, handicrafts, and street food.

opening_hours.notes: Closed on public holidays.

places.place_tip: Bargain for souvenirs and try the local street food.

places.name: Salt Fields of Kampot
places.ai_summary: The Salt Fields of Kampot are unique coastal salt farms where visitors can learn about traditional salt production.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited during the salt harvesting season.

places.place_tip: Bring a hat and sunscreen, as it can be hot.

places.ai_summary: Secret Lake, also known as Brateak Krola Lake, is a hidden gem near Kampot, perfect for a peaceful retreat.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited during the dry season.

places.place_tip: Bring a picnic and enjoy the serene environment.

places.ai_summary: Teuk Chhou Rapids is a popular spot for picnicking and enjoying the natural beauty of the river and surrounding area.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited during the dry season.

places.place_tip: Enjoy a swim in the natural pools.

opening_hours.notes: A popular photo spot, especially at night when it's illuminated.

places.place_tip: Try the local durian fruit from nearby stalls.

places.ai_summary: Kep Sailing Club & Jetty is a recreational area in Kep, ideal for sailing, boating, and enjoying the coastal scenery.

opening_hours.notes: Check for sailing schedules and availability.

places.place_tip: Bring your own sailing gear or rent from local providers.
places.address: Kep Sailing Club & Jetty, Kep, Cambodia

places.name: Lotus Pond Café Area
places.ai_summary: The Lotus Pond Café Area is a picturesque spot in Kampot, featuring a pond with blooming lotus flowers and a café for relaxation.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in the morning for photography.

places.place_tip: Try the lotus tea and snacks at the café.

places.place_tip: Walk or cycle across the bridge for the best views.

places.place_tip: Try the local street food and buy handmade crafts.
